cands.name: Wyatt Gable
cands.bio: Republican member of the North Carolina House for District 14 since January 2025. He defeated 10-term incumbent George Cleveland in the 2024 primary. Graduated from East Carolina University in May 2025 (B.S. Business Management) and is a former president of ECU's Turning Point USA chapter.
cands.gaps: His birthplace and the year he moved to North Carolina are not stated in the pages we could read. We found no jobs outside student activities and the legislature. The sponsored-legislation list on his Ballotpedia page was empty, so we could not confirm any bills he sponsored. We found no documented actions or stated positions from him on data centers, homestead property taxes, land buying by investors or foreigners, growth and land protection, immigration or H-1B, police pay, gun laws, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. We found no public statements from him on data centers or development, no documented controversies, no foreign ties, and no endorsements. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2024 or 2026.

local.label: Roots 90: His campaign site says he has lived in Jacksonville/Onslow County for over 16 years, and he graduated from White Oak High School in 2021, so he was raised in North Carolina; his birthplace is not stated.
